name: Hide and Paint VR
summary:
The only and top selling VR chameleon game with Mod Maps! Strike any pose and paint yourself by hand to blend in like a chameleon while avoiding Hunters!

# Mod Maps!
Our Community has created tons of Mod Maps that you know and love in addition to default maps like Grocery, Office, Gallery and more.
